name: intentrax
description: Intentrax execution assurance for AI coding agents: skills to find consequential agent actions and wire admit -> execute -> verify, plus an optional read-only MCP server for proof verification.

plugins.name: intentrax-execution-assurance
plugins.description: Skills for agent-built apps: decide when an action deserves a verifiable proof, find consequential agent actions, wire admission -> execution -> verification with the Intentrax SDK, and check proofs honestly.

plugins.name: intentrax-mcp
plugins.description: Read-only Intentrax MCP server for Claude Code: verify a public proof (keyless) or read a tenant-scoped proof. Never executes, admits, signs, or writes.
